items.name: parenthesized_range
items.signature: fn parenthesized_range(expr: ExprRef<'_>, parent: AnyNodeRef<'_>, comment_ranges: &ruff_python_trivia::CommentRanges, source: &str) -> Option<ruff_text_size::TextRange>
